title: Team Setup (party and stats)
hexereiTitle: Completed the Hexerei quest (Hexerei character). With 2 or more Hexerei characters in the party, the "Hexerei: Secret Rite" effect is gained (gcsim's `hex` parameter; completed by default)
clearConfirm: Clear all characters and all actions?
clearAllTitle: Empty the 4 character slots and all actions (stints) on the timeline (confirmed with "Save & apply team")
moveLeftTitle: Move this character to the slot on the left
moveRightTitle: Move this character to the slot on the right
weaponMissing: This weapon is not implemented in gcsim. It cannot be used in gcsim calculations (it causes an error).
artifact22Title: 2+2 has no triggered set buffs, so no artifact set can be chosen (switch back to 4-Piece to choose one)
artifactMissing: This artifact set is not implemented in gcsim. It cannot be used in gcsim calculations (it causes an error).
artifactModeTitle: Artifact combination (2+2 has no triggered 4-Piece buffs)
twoTwoNote: 2+2: no triggered set buffs (artifact set fixed to no effect)
searchPlaceholder: Search by name, English name or ID...
noMatchHint: Clear the element/weapon filters or change the search keyword.
footerHint: Changes are applied when you press "Save & apply team"
trueMoonTitle: Traveler: whether the story quest "True Moon" is completed (the buffs apply if it is; gcsim's default is completed). Switchable per party, like constellations and Revelation
notOwnedTitle: Not in the imported owned characters (shown on every character if you have not imported yet)

owned.summaryAvailable: Imported: Lv.{{level}}/{{max}}, C{{cons}}, {{weapon}}. Using it sets weapon, artifacts and constellation, plus level, talents and artifact stats, to the imported values
owned.summaryActive: Lv.{{level}}/{{max}} / Talents {{talents}} / Weapon Lv.{{weaponLevel}} / {{stats}} artifact stats
owned.note: Changing the weapon, artifacts, refinement or constellation by hand, or editing the stats, stops applying the owned build & stats (back to defaults). The required energy recharge calculation uses the initial defaults

stats.title: Edit stats (defaults)
stats.intro: Edit the stats that are not in the party settings (constellation, Revelation, Hexerei, weapon, artifacts). The saved values become this slot's defaults and are used for gcsim calculations.
stats.introOwned: The owned character's build & stats are filled in. Saving stops applying them and the edited values become the defaults (weapon, artifacts and constellation stay as they are).
stats.artifactStatsHint: Enter the total of main and sub stats. Enter % stats as percentages (e.g. Crit Rate 70.5). Blank is 0.
stats.finalInvalid: Cannot calculate: some inputs are invalid
stats.finalUnsupported: Not shown: this character is not implemented in gcsim
stats.finalNote: Base stats of the character and weapon, plus the artifact stats below and the weapon/talent effects gcsim adds at the start. Read-only; it changes when you edit the artifact stats below.
